title: Tunisian Vegetable Tagine
description: A flavorful and aromatic North African stew originating from Tunisia, typically made with meat or vegetables. This version is a vegetarian twist on the classic dish.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the bottom of a clay or ceramic tagine over medium heat.
Add the onion and garlic and sauté until softened.
Add the tunisian vegetable tagine spice blend and sauté for 1 minute.
Add the carrots, potatoes, diced tomatoes, chickpeas, and water to the tagine.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 30 minutes.
Season with the zest of 1 lemon and serve hot.
Serve with couscous or crusty bread for a complete meal.
Garnish with fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
This stew can be made ahead and refrigerated or frozen for later use.
